definitions.gloss: retail store; sales outlet; authorized dealer
definitions.explanation: A shop that sells goods to the public. Often used to refer to authorized or designated retailers for specific brands or products.

examples.japanese: {最寄|もよ}りの{販売店|はんばいてん}で{買|か}う。
examples.english: To buy at the nearest retail store.

examples.japanese: {正規|せいき}{販売店|はんばいてん}でしか{購入|こうにゅう}できません。
examples.english: It can only be purchased at an authorized dealer.

examples.japanese: {全国|ぜんこく}の{販売店|はんばいてん}で{来月|らいげつ}から{取|と}り{扱|あつか}いが{始|はじ}まる。
examples.english: Sales will begin at retail stores nationwide starting next month.

notes:
Composed of {販売|はんばい} (sales) + {店|てん} (shop). A general term for any shop that sells goods. In practice, often used with qualifiers to indicate the type of store.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正規|せいき}{販売店|はんばいてん}: authorized dealer
- {特約|とくやく}{販売店|はんばいてん}: exclusive dealership
- {指定|してい}{販売店|はんばいてん}: designated retailer
- {販売店|はんばいてん}{一覧|いちらん}: list of retail stores

RELATED WORDS:
- {小売店|こうりてん}: retail shop — more specific to retail (as opposed to wholesale)
- {取扱店|とりあつかいてん}: authorized handler/dealer — emphasizes being licensed to sell
- {卸売店|おろしうりてん}: wholesaler — sells in bulk to other businesses
